node.statement: The maximal conclusion licensed by the allowed inputs is the approximate-group conclusion for the map denoted u_delta by lem-stage1-approximate-group-laws. Steps 1.1--1.3 establish the scalar guards of that lemma, so its C^1 formulas, exact basepoint identities, and five A*epsilon_r estimates follow and then weaken to C_grp*epsilon_r. But the additional root assertion R that Pi_delta(U,H)=U bold-dot H is bijective from calU x B_delta^{calH}(J) onto S_delta with unique inverse (u_delta,h_delta), whose first component is that same u_delta, is neither a conclusion of the external nor a definitional fact: def-approximate-unitary-space expressly reserves u,h only as partial notation and asserts no inverse theorem. Hence the proof establishes G but not R, while the root requires R and G; the assertion in child 1.5 that the inverse and domains are unchanged has no supporting premise and cannot discharge R.
